title: Puthoff and Green introduce owner to Bigelow

tellings.quote: I'm thankful that they trusted me, that they reached out to me with the opportunity to meet with Mr. Bigelow.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2016 two men, Hal Puthoff and Kit Green, reached out to him. He says they offered him the chance to meet Robert Bigelow, and that he is thankful they trusted him. It is part of his story of how he came to the ranch and its claimed secrets.
